findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:483 WHY validateRunWorkspaceBinding verifies workspaceBinding against itself and checks that signedWorkspaceRoot is still a usable git root, but it never re-resolves the story current signed workspace from metadataRoot/config. In split-root wrapper projects, changing gitRoot after review_run_start can leave existing pass/finding evidence valid against the old repo while story_resolve/review_run_start now point at a different signedWorkspaceRoot. That violates the intended start/consumer consistency and can let REVIEW pass on the wrong material root.
